name: Hotel Jeevan Manchar
why_it_matters: Reliable Pune-Nashik highway anchor at Manchar — the natural lunch stop for the Lenyadri-Ozar leg of the Astavinayak circuit (both temples 45km from here). Multi-cuisine pure-veg with Maharashtrian thali as the safe-bet lunch order. Ample parking, clean toilets — the rare-on-NH-50 combo.
insider_tip: Maharashtrian thali (₹250) at lunch is the order; for non-pilgrim road-trippers, the Punjabi paneer butter masala is the value option. Open 7am-10:30pm.

name: Vrundavan Pure Veg
why_it_matters: Pure-veg eatery 190m from Theur Chintamani Vinayaka temple — the natural post-darshan lunch stop on the Astavinayak Pune-east leg. Maharashtrian thali + modak are the orders. Most Astavinayak pilgrim groups eat here between Theur and Ranjangaon.
insider_tip: Open 7am-9pm. Modak available daily (steamed; not just festival-only). Cash + UPI; weekend pilgrim queues 12-2pm — eat at 11am or 3pm.
signature_address: Theur, Haveli taluka, ~30km east of Pune, Theur 412110

name: Hotel Sukh Sagar Pali
why_it_matters: Pure-veg Maharashtrian thali stop in Pali, the Ballaleshwar Astavinayak temple base — listed on Tripadvisor + Restaurant Guru + Wanderlog. Closest reliable dining to the temple. Open 7am-10pm.
insider_tip: Modak fresh-steamed daily; ask if you want a take-away box. Pithla bhakri (gram-flour curry + jowar flatbread) is the village-Maharashtrian signature.
signature_address: Pali, Sudhagad taluka, Raigad District, Pali 410205

name: Annapurna Bhojanalaya (Mahaganpati Temple Trust)
why_it_matters: Temple-trust-run kitchen (annapurna bhojanalaya) inside the Mahaganpati Temple complex at Ranjangaon — pure-veg, mostly subsidised Maharashtrian thali for pilgrims. The trust kitchen serves prasad-style meals, not commercial restaurant cuisine. Used by all Astavinayak group tours doing the Pune-Ahmednagar leg.
insider_tip: Lunch service 12-2pm only; arrive by 12:15 to avoid the post-aarti rush. Donation-based or fixed token (₹80-100). Cash only. Outside donation box at exit.
signature_address: Mahaganpati Temple, Ranjangaon, Shirur taluka, Pune-Ahmednagar Hwy NH-753, Ranjangaon 412209

name: Hotel Nagari Major Kashti
area: Kashti (Shrigonda taluka, Ahmednagar district), en-route to Siddhatek
why_it_matters: Highway dhaba-anchor at Kashti junction (Shrigonda taluka) — the natural lunch stop on the Pune-Siddhatek leg of Astavinayak (Siddhatek temple 35km east on the Bhima river). Justdial-listed with 'Maswadi Thali Special' as its anchor. Mid-priced pure-veg, clean by Maharashtra-highway standards.
insider_tip: Kashti is on the Pune-Aurangabad route — the road from Kashti to Siddhatek crosses the Bhima river at Padharadi ferry/bridge; ask waiter for the ferry status before crossing. Open 7am-10pm.
signature_address: Kashti junction, Shrigonda taluka, Ahmednagar district, Kashti 413701
